annotations.title: Household energy suppliers with their products and where to find the bill

description: Facts from the suppliers' official price lists (verified: false: the yearly calculation built on them is not yet checked by an independent expert; estimate_note gives the sentence and the day of the price lists). Every household electricity and gas supplier of a country we know of (Czechia: 46), or one supplier with `id`: its official price-list page, whether we priced it (status priced | gap with the reason), its products with the prices of the official price lists (electricity: commodity price per MWh by rate and the monthly fee; gas: price and fee by consumption band; all without VAT, with source_url, valid_from and verified_on), whether each price is fixed and until when, and the bill guide (bill_guide: the customer portal and the steps to find and download the bill, from the supplier's own help page). Former suppliers (e.g. Bohemia Energy) are listed with what happened to their customers. No contract can be signed here and no link earns a commission.

id.description: Supplier id from the list, e.g. cez-prodej.

locale.description: Language of the bill guide steps: cs | sk | en (default en).
